issues.description: Class GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit: the template defines the constructor with a parameter (def __init__(self, num_qubits: int)) while the solution defines a no-argument constructor (def __init__(self)). The template also contains an example instantiation that calls GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit() with no arguments. This mismatch will cause students following the template examples or the solution to encounter a runtime TypeError when instantiating the class, and it is unclear which constructor signature they should implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor signature consistent between template and solution. Preferred fix: change the template constructor to a no-argument signature (def __init__(self):) and keep the internal initialization behavior (set number_of_qubits_query_register = 2 in the template) so that example usages like GroverTwoQubitWithoutAuxiliaryQubit() work. Alternatively, if a parameterized constructor is intended, update all example usages and the solution to pass the required num_qubits argument and document the expected parameter clearly.
